data.name: Intro_Title
data.value: Introduction

data.name: Intro_P1
data.value: This Privacy Policy explains how Vitinerario collects, uses, shares, and protects the personal data of users who access the mobile app and related services.

data.name: Intro_P2
data.value: Use of the app may involve the processing of certain technical and usage information necessary to operate the service, improve the user experience, measure performance, and, where applicable, display advertising.

data.name: Intro_P3
data.value: By using Vitinerario, the user acknowledges this notice. Where required by applicable law, processing subject to consent will only take place after such consent has been validly provided.

data.name: Data_Title
data.value: Data collected

data.name: Data_P1
data.value: While using the app, we may collect, directly or through third-party providers integrated into the application, certain categories of personal and technical data.

data.name: Data_Item1
data.value: Technical device information such as model, operating system, language, app version, and general device parameters.

data.name: Data_Item2
data.value: IP address, online identifiers, and device identifiers, including advertising IDs where used for advertising or analytics purposes.

data.name: Data_Item3
data.value: Usage and interaction data, such as screens viewed, time spent in the app, in-app events, and interactions with content or features.

data.name: Data_Item4
data.value: Diagnostic data, crash logs, performance information, and data related to the proper functioning of the application.

data.name: Data_Item5
data.value: Any information voluntarily provided by the user through contact requests or communications sent to the developer.

data.name: Data_P2
data.value: The data actually processed may vary depending on the app configuration, device settings, the user’s Google account settings, consent choices, and enabled services.

data.name: Usage_Title
data.value: Use of data

data.name: Usage_Box_Title
data.value: Why we process this data

data.name: Usage_Box_Text
data.value: Data is processed solely for purposes related to providing the service, security, analytics, app improvement, and, where applicable, advertising management.

data.name: Usage_P1
data.value: In particular, data may be used to provide app features, monitor stability and performance, analyze service usage, prevent abuse or malfunction, and improve the overall quality of the user experience.

data.name: Usage_P2
data.value: If AdMob ads are displayed, some data may also be processed for ad delivery, measurement, and optimization, in accordance with the user’s choices and applicable law.

data.name: ThirdParty_Title
data.value: Third-party services

data.name: ThirdParty_P1
data.value: The application integrates third-party services that may process data on their own behalf or on behalf of the controller, in accordance with their respective terms and privacy notices.

data.name: ThirdParty_P2
data.value: These providers may process data such as IP address, device identifiers, diagnostic information, usage statistics, interactions with content, and information required to provide their services.

data.name: ThirdParty_Box_Title
data.value: Services currently used

data.name: ThirdParty_Item1
data.value: Firebase: infrastructure, technical analytics, possible crash reporting, and related services.

data.name: ThirdParty_Item2
data.value: Google Analytics for Firebase: collection of events and aggregated statistics regarding app usage.

data.name: ThirdParty_Item3
data.value: Google AdMob: display and measurement of ads, including possible management of personalized or non-personalized advertising.

data.name: ThirdParty_P3
data.value: For more details about processing carried out by these providers, users should also consult the privacy notices published by the respective providers.

data.name: Rights_Title
data.value: Rights and security

data.name: Rights_P1
data.value: We adopt reasonable technical and organizational measures to protect data against unauthorized access, loss, disclosure, alteration, or destruction. However, no method of transmission or electronic storage can be considered completely secure.

data.name: Rights_Item1
data.value: Where applicable, users may request information about processed data, as well as access, rectification, erasure, or restriction of processing.

data.name: Rights_Item2
data.value: Users may object to processing based on legitimate interest, where provided by law.

data.name: Rights_Item3
data.value: Users may manage certain preferences directly through their device, their Google account, or any consent tools displayed in the app.

data.name: Rights_Item4
data.value: Where required by applicable law, users may withdraw previously given consent at any time, without affecting the lawfulness of processing carried out before withdrawal.

data.name: Rights_P2
data.value: Where data is processed by third-party providers such as Google, Firebase, or AdMob, part of the information may be retained and processed according to their own policies and retention periods.

data.name: Changes_Title
data.value: Changes to this Privacy Policy and contact

data.name: Changes_P1
data.value: We reserve the right to update or modify this Privacy Policy from time to time in order to reflect legal, technical, or organizational changes, as well as the evolution of the services provided.

data.name: Changes_P2
data.value: The most current version will always be published on this page together with the latest update date. Where material changes occur, we may adopt additional notice measures where required by applicable law.
